principles: The new sub-check is FAIL-OPEN (own try/catch -> allow); never let a gate/config infra error block PLAN->DEV (spec 4.8).
Enforce the block ONLY under mode===block; advise/off never hard-block (they are Story 4 advisory surfaces).
One shared predicate/helper feeds BOTH canStartDevGuard (boolean) and getGuardFailureReason (message) so they cannot drift.
Reuse merged primitives unchanged (evaluateDecompositionGate, resolveAuditConfig, safeReadScopeContract, computeWriteSet) — add no overlap/gate logic.
Preserve the existing review-gate fail-closed semantics; the parallel sub-check is additive and isolated.
drivers: A config/infra error must not strand every story at PLAN (fail-open)
decision and message must not diverge (shared predicate)
must not regress the existing fail-closed review gate

options.name: shared-helper-fail-open
pros: single source for the block decision + message (no drift)
fail-open isolated in its own try/catch
cons: machine.ts gains a small helper + peer/contract loading

options.name: duplicate-inline-both
cons: decision and message can drift (the exact failure the two-coordinated-edits spec warns about)
easy to make one fail-open and the other not

rationale: A shared helper computing the parallel block (peers + contracts + evaluateDecompositionGate, gated on mode===block) is called by BOTH canStartDevGuard (returns false when block is non-null) and getGuardFailureReason (renders the message), so the boolean decision and the human reason stay in sync. Each call site wraps it in its OWN try/catch that fails OPEN (guard -> allow; reason -> null), isolating the fail-open boundary from the surrounding fail-closed review gate. Reuses merged Stories 0-4 primitives, no new overlap logic.

preMortem.scenario: A config typo or transient read error makes the gate sub-check fail CLOSED, bricking PLAN->DEV for EVERY story
preMortem.trigger: the sub-check is placed inside the outer fail-closed try, or its own catch returns false
preMortem.consequence: the team is stranded at PLAN by a config mistake — the inversion the gate must avoid
preMortem.mitigation: the sub-check is in its OWN nested try/catch that on ANY error falls through to allow; a smoke asserts a throwing gate-config => canStartDevGuard returns true (fail-open)

preMortem.scenario: canStartDevGuard blocks but getGuardFailureReason returns null (or vice-versa)
preMortem.trigger: the boolean decision and the message are computed by separate drifting code paths
preMortem.consequence: operator sees a silent block or a phantom message — undebuggable
preMortem.mitigation: both call the ONE shared block-predicate helper; a smoke asserts that when the guard is false for a parallel block, the reason is a non-null message naming the block, and both pass together for a clean wave

preMortem.scenario: The gate hard-blocks under mode=advise or mode=off, breaking the advisory-only contract and the reversible escape hatch
preMortem.trigger: the mode===block guard is missing or wrong (e.g. mode!==off instead of mode===block)
preMortem.consequence: advise/off operators get unexpected hard blocks; the escape hatch is broken
preMortem.mitigation: enforce the block strictly under cfg.mode===block; smoke asserts the same overlap that blocks under mode=block returns true under both advise and off
